walk_forward_validation.method: Rolling 750-day train / 21-day test / 21-day step across 19 NSE stocks (2019-2024)
walk_forward_validation.key_finding: Walk-forward R2 is lower than naive persistence baseline for all 7 horizons. The model's genuine edge is directional classification (70.67% Day-1) not price-level prediction.

summary.validation_integrity: Walk-forward validation with 1,026 independent forward windows; Optuna tuning was performed on static split only and NOT used inside walk-forward loop
summary.key_insight: Rolling price and volume normalization (252-day baseline) eliminated non-stationarity drift across diverse Indian stocks. The model's primary value is directional accuracy (70.67% Day-1), not absolute price prediction — in line with efficient market hypothesis expectations.
summary.honest_limitation: Walk-forward R2 is consistently lower than the naive persistence baseline. High static-split R2 (>0.98) reflects the non-stationary nature of price levels, not genuine predictive power over a random walk.
